parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the 'Wallpaper' package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and therefore carries sample-app semantics. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a sample-app file warrants no-action, because lifting production code into shared infrastructure to eliminate this duplicate would couple production targets to demonstration-context semantics. The production copy in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel) is intentionally self-contained, and the sample-app copy is a local convenience that mirrors it for demonstration purposes.
